name: anchor: acknowledge distress
utterance: I can see this is really overwhelming for you right now.

name: anchor: environmental + caregiver
utterance: Let me dim the lights and ask the other staff to step out. And can we get your mom to come in?

name: anchor: force IV + authoritative tone
utterance: We need to get this IV in right now, just hold still.

name: anchor: neutral history question scores nothing
utterance: Can you tell me your date of birth?

name: paraphrase: acknowledge distress without the stock phrasing
utterance: That must have been really scary when the nurse tried the needle.

name: paraphrase: environmental without the word 'dim'
utterance: I'm going to turn these overhead lights down and clear a couple of people out of the room.

name: coverage: offer control
utterance: Do you want to sit up, or would you rather lie back? Whichever you'd prefer.

name: coverage: delay procedure
utterance: We don't have to do the IV right now — we can come back to it once you're ready.

name: dedup: environmental mentioned twice counts once
utterance: Let me dim the lights. Actually, let me get these lights down as low as they go and shut the door too.

name: near-miss: hedged mention of restraint is not Restraint
utterance: If this keeps going we may need to consider other options, but I'd much rather not.

name: near-miss: naming the IV is not Force IV
utterance: The nurse tried to place an IV earlier and I know that hurt.

name: near-miss: a firm but calm boundary is not Authoritative tone
utterance: I'll stay over here by the door so you have some space.

name: negative: restraint clearly directed
utterance: I'm going to have security hold him down and we'll give him something to sedate him.

name: combination: verbal communication plus offer control
utterance: I'm going to explain everything before I do it, and you can tell me when you're ready.

name: neutral: small talk scores nothing
utterance: It's pretty busy out there tonight, huh.
